def op_00 : Nat → Int → Int → Int → Int → Int × Int × Int × Int
  | 0, a, b, c, d => (a,b,c,d)
  | n+1, a, b, c, d => op_00 n (a+2*c) (b+2*d) (c+3*(a+2*c)) (d+3*(b+2*d))

theorem pt_00 (n : Nat) (a b c d : Int) :
    (op_00 n a b c d).1*(op_00 n a b c d).2.2.2 - (op_00 n a b c d).2.1*(op_00 n a b c d).2.2.1 = a*d-b*c := by
witness:
have inv : ∀ (m : Nat) (a b c d : Int),
      (op_00 m a b c d).1*(op_00 m a b c d).2.2.2 - (op_00 m a b c d).2.1*(op_00 m a b c d).2.2.1 = a*d-b*c := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intros; rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intros
      simp only [op_00]
      rw [ih]
      ring
  exact inv n a b c d

    (op_04 n a b c d).1 ≠ 0 ∨ (op_04 n a b c d).2.1 ≠ 0 := by

  by_contra hh

  have hi := inv n a b c d

def op_08 : Nat → Int → Int → Int → Int → Int × Int × Int × Int
  | 0, a, b, c, d => (a,b,c,d)
  | n+1, a, b, c, d => op_08 n (a+2*c) (b+2*d) (c+3*(a+2*c)) (d+3*(b+2*d))

theorem pt_08 (n : Nat) (a b c d : Int) (h : a*d-b*c = 1) :
    ∃ u v : Int, u*(op_08 n a b c d).1 + v*(op_08 n a b c d).2.1 = 1 := by
witness:
have inv : ∀ (m : Nat) (a b c d : Int),
      (op_08 m a b c d).1*(op_08 m a b c d).2.2.2 - (op_08 m a b c d).2.1*(op_08 m a b c d).2.2.1 = a*d-b*c := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intros; rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intros
      simp only [op_08]
      rw [ih]
      ring
  refine ⟨(op_08 n a b c d).2.2.2, -(op_08 n a b c d).2.2.1, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = (op_08 n a b c d).1*(op_08 n a b c d).2.2.2 - (op_08 n a b c d).2.1*(op_08 n a b c d).2.2.1 := by ring
    _ = a*d-b*c := inv n a b c d
    _ = 1 := h

noncomputable def op_12 : Nat → Real → Real
  | 0, x => x
  | n+1, x => op_12 n (x/(1+2*x))

theorem pt_12 (n : Nat) (x : Real) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    op_12 n x = x/(1+2*(n:Real)*x) := by
witness:
induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [op_12]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hd : 0 < 1+2*x := by positivity
    have hy : 0 ≤ x/(1+2*x) := div_nonneg hx (le_of_lt hd)
    rw [op_12, ih _ hy]
    push_cast
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n:Real) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have he : 0 < 1+2*(n:Real)*(x/(1+2*x)) := by positivity
    have hf : 0 < 1+2*((n:Real)+1)*x := by positivity
    field_simp [_root_.ne_of_gt hd, _root_.ne_of_gt he, _root_.ne_of_gt hf]
    <;> ring <;> simp

    (hp : ∀ z, P (ProbeTree.tip z)) (hq : ∀ z, Q (ProbeTree.tip z))
    (sp : ∀ a b, P a → Q a → P b → Q b → P (ProbeTree.node a b))
    (sq : ∀ a b, P a → Q a → P b → Q b → P (ProbeTree.node a b) → Q (ProbeTree.node a b)) :

theorem target (P : Nat → Nat → Prop) (h0 : P 0 0)
    (hs : ∀ i j, P i j → P (i+1) j) (ht : ∀ i j, P i j → P i (j+1)) :
    ∀ i j, P i j := by
witness:
intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro j
    induction j <;> aesop
  | succ i ih =>
    intro j
    exact hs i j (ih j)

theorem target (P : List Int → Nat → Prop) (h0 : P [] 0)
    (hs : ∀ a xs n, P xs n → P (a :: xs) n) (ht : ∀ xs n, P xs n → P xs (n+1)) :
    ∀ xs n, P xs n := by
witness:
intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
    intro n
    induction n <;> aesop
  | cons a xs ih =>
    intro n
    exact hs a xs n (ih n)
